topic: Tight hamstrings: massage, stretching and strength

slides.headline: Hamstrings always tight? Try all three
slides.sub: Massage, stretching and strength each play a different role.

slides.title: Tight doesn't always mean short
slides.body: Hamstrings can feel tight because they're tired, protective or underloaded, not only because they lack length. That's why stretching alone doesn't always change the feeling for long.

slides.title: Where massage fits
slides.body: Remedial massage can help tight hamstrings feel easier and make movement more comfortable in the short term. It's a useful window to follow up with movement and strength work.

slides.title: Stretch, but keep it easy
slides.body: Gentle, regular stretching, like a supported hamstring stretch held for about 30 seconds, can improve how much stretch you tolerate. It shouldn't feel sharp or nervy.

slides.title: Strength is the long game
slides.body: Bridges, Romanian deadlifts and slow hamstring curls build capacity through range. Two sessions a week is a good starting point, and many people find their hamstrings feel less tight once they're stronger.

slides.title: Check the back and nerves too
slides.body: Tightness with tingling, pain down the leg or low back pain may involve more than muscle, such as the lower back or a nerve. Your therapist may suggest a physio or GP assessment if so.

slides.headline: Hamstrings still grumbling?
slides.body: Our remedial massage therapists combine hands-on work with simple ideas for stretching and strength at home. Book online, link in bio.

caption:
Stretching your hamstrings every day and they still feel tight? You might be missing a piece.

Hamstrings can feel tight because they're tired, protective or underloaded, not just short. That's why stretching alone often gives short-lived relief.

Think of it as three tools. Remedial massage can help things feel easier in the short term. Gentle stretching improves how much stretch you tolerate. And strength work like bridges and Romanian deadlifts builds capacity, which many people find eases that tight feeling over time. Tingling or pain spreading down the leg is worth a physio or GP assessment.

story.headline: Tight hamstrings on repeat?
story.body: Pair massage and gentle stretching with bridges or Romanian deadlifts twice a week.
